description: Alabama CDL delta. Air brakes, cargo, and hours stay in core_cdl.json.

questions.q: The minimum age to drive a commercial vehicle from Alabama into another state is
questions.explanation: Interstate commerce requires the driver to be at least 21. That federal age applies to a driver leaving this state.

questions.q: You live in Alabama and drive a CMV. Who issues the CDL?
options: The state that titled the truck
The state where the load started
questions.explanation: A CDL is issued by your state of domicile, the state where you live.

questions.q: In Alabama, what is the youngest age to drive a commercial vehicle only within the state?
questions.explanation: Alabama allows intrastate commercial driving at 18 years; interstate driving requires 21.

provenance.manual: Intrastate Commercial Motor Vehicle Regulations | ALEA
